action.title: Governing Law Clause

action.summary: This matter involved a review of the Kestrel Master Services Agreement and the Security Exhibit against Meridian's cloud negotiation playbook. Key issues identified included the governing law clause and data privacy protections. We proposed redlines to address these concerns, emphasizing the need for a choice of law clause reflecting the state of California and robust data privacy protections. The client has been advised to insist on these terms to protect their interests.
